theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tl_ald_ld_weighted_lebesgue_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ f : Eucl P → ℝ) (y : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M μ → (∀ z ∈ M, 0 < θ z) → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall y r) μ → IntegrableOn (fun z => θ z * f z) (M ∩ closedBall y r) μ → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict (M ∩ ball y r)), Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ z in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ z) * ‖f z - f x‖ₑ ∂μ) / (∫⁻ z in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ z) ∂μ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
